candidate.core_job: Trace possibly tampered cryptographic devices from reseller purchase to stock quarantine, authorized inspection, customer notification and remediation signoff
candidate.target_customer: Hardware-wallet and industrial secure-element device distributors, regulated retail channel auditors and corporate asset-security teams
candidate.buyer: Distributor supply-chain quality or incident response manager
candidate.product_mechanism: User-entered supplier/reseller, order date, invoice, device serial, seal/photo inspection, lot, location, quarantine/suspicious indicator, communication and closure evidence; CSV/PDF export. Does not scan wallets, read seed phrases, verify chips or handle funds.
candidate.why_now: ZDNET 12 October reports Ledger suspended reseller CryptoBilis over hardware wallet spy-implant discovery in Southeast Asia; BleepingComputer independent reporting also describes third-party sales-channel tampering. Physical implant cannot be ruled out by standard software wallet authenticity checks. USD 86m is researcher attributed, NOT Ledger audited total. Defensive manufacturer/reseller acceptance evidence and quarantine records offer a manual no-external-API workflow.
candidate.before_state: Device purchase provenance, third-party inspection evidence and customer communications in disparate spreadsheets/email; chip-tampering cannot be established from a normal software authenticity signal
candidate.after_state: Lot-level containment / contact log / inspection evidence / disposition with human approval and traceable corrective action
candidate.merge_note: Bu girdi diğer 166 kayıtla müşteri+iş+mekanizma temelinde karşılaştırıldı; doğrudan semantik mükerrer bulunmadı. Rakip/doğrulama hükmü değildir.
candidate.source_evidence_caveat: Kaynak URL'leri ve why_now gözlemleri Discovery'den devralındı. Bu Merge aşaması yeni bir kaynak okuyup page_read kanıtı üretmez.
